a.title: Fujifilm plans 5x production boost of 100TB magnetic storage tapes driven by skyrocketing AI storage demand — $63 million injection is the largest investment in tape for 20 years

b.lede: Low costs and offline security mean magnetic tape still has a job.
b.title: Fujifilm to boost tape production 5x as AI fuels archiving demand
